sprint: Home Button — Skip the Gateway Cinematic, Land on My Projects
task: Real, direct report: 'the press of home button from studio is taking out to very first screen tap to begin. it should be taking us to projects page as it was previously.' Root cause -- the Home button's own earlier fix (discardSession()+window.location.reload(), needed to genuinely reset AppState so a new theme never inherits the previous one's Story-owned content) never distinguished a genuine fresh page load from a Home-triggered reload; both are plain page loads, so both replayed the full Traveller Gateway cinematic (js/gatewaySequence.js's Sky/Lumo/'Tap to Begin' sequence, unconditional on every launch per the Canon Update Sprint) before Creation Flow ever appeared, and even then always landed on Screen 1's Type-choice grid rather than 'Continue a Project.' Fix -- a dedicated, one-shot sessionStorage flag (HOME_RETURN_FLAG='vihu-home-return-to-projects'), set only by the Home click handler right before reload and read+consumed exactly once at the very top of the next boot's _runBootstrap() (js/app.js): when present, boot skips straight to _beginBoot() (bypassing both the Gateway cinematic and _afterGateway()'s own standalone identity-gate fallback -- MagicCard's active identity survives discardSession() untouched, so there's nothing left to re-verify) and tells _startCreationFlow() to open CreationFlow.start({screen:'myProjects'}) instead of the bare Type-choice call. js/creationFlow.js's start() function widened to accept this opts param -- opens _renderMyProjectsScreen() ('Continue a Project') when at least one real project exists, falling through to the ordinary Type screen otherwise, mirroring the exact 'never a dead-end' precedent _deleteProjectRecord already established for the last-project-deleted case. The Gateway's own 'every launch, known device or not' rule is left completely intact for every real fresh load/refresh -- only this one button's own reload ever sets the flag, and it's removed the instant it's read, so it can never leak into a genuine subsequent reload. Verified via two new Playwright suites (home_button_myprojects_test.js, 10/10 -- a real seeded My Projects record, pressing the real #homeBtn, confirming the Gateway overlay stays hidden and no 'Tap to Begin' gate ever shows, the flag is consumed, and Creation Flow lands directly on 'Continue a Project' showing the real seeded project, not the Type-choice grid; home_button_edgecases_test.js, 5/5 -- a genuine fresh page load still shows the full Gateway cinematic exactly as before, and Home pressed with zero My Projects records still correctly falls back to the Type-choice screen) plus a fix to the pre-existing home_button_leak_repro.js scratch regression (the earlier theme-bleed-prevention test) confirming the AppState-reset guarantee that fix depends on is completely unaffected -- its own second pickThemeAndStart() call now backs out via the My Projects screen's own real '<- Back' link first, the disclosed, intended consequence of this fix (a real autosaved project now correctly redirects Home there) rather than a regression; re-verified 6/6 passing, zero console errors. myprojects_test.js/myprojects_test2.js's own pre-existing, already-documented stale locator (predating the Traveller Gateway's own skip-helper convention) confirmed via git stash to fail identically on the unmodified baseline, unrelated to this fix. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; tools/world-builder-v2/ and tools/world-builder/ (v1) are both completely untouched -- confined entirely to js/app.js and js/creationFlow.js.
